title: Account Change event (IAM account mutation telemetry for identity-compromise persistence removal)
summary: OCSF Account Change events the identity-compromise playbook consumes during the IAM-audit and persistence-removal step. Surfaces account state changes performed against (or by) the compromised principal: MFA disablement, app-password creation, conditional-access exception edits, OAuth consent grants, new device registrations, and standing-privilege role assignments.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Identity & Access Management category — Account Change class (uid 3001)
